protocol: Second blind cohort. Kept apart from the first-use five-video set examined during rule development. Source selection and manual completion windows frozen from RGB alone before either candidate is evaluated on these files. Four independent publishers and performers. Fixed normal gym front, rear and oblique views plus a separately identifiable edited outdoor machine case. Single reviewer, no independent adjudication. Reference windows [lowest handle, subsequent completed overhead return] in clip-relative seconds, observed at 4 Hz (6 Hz for Future Fitness). First three complete top-to-top reps are always calibration. Source IDs, titles, performers, rooms and file digests screened against the previous project and first-use cohort. Video-based frame differences and visual reviews found no repeated-playback loop in the selected windows. This is a small purposive cohort, not population-level accuracy. Do not tune using this cohort and report it separately if the first cohort prompted revisions.
screeningExclusions: Workout-Vision public demo and iPhone MOV: both contain another system’s burned-in skeleton and rep counter, verified visually.
Salford Community Leisure and Castle Hill Fitness: too few contiguous complete cycles for post-calibration evaluation.
Umeda: split-screen two demonstrations. HOIST/RX: edited multishot montage with repeated exercise illustrations.
Montgomery College: close-view clip pans vertically until most of the body is outside the image; later views resemble earlier ones in reverse. Used no rep windows from it.
